Descrição da vaga ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando‑se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições   Analisar datasets/modelos semânticos e dashboards (Power BI/Fabric) para identificar gargalos de performance, inconsistências e oportunidades de melhoria (modelagem, DAX, relacionamento, cardinalidade, agregações, etc.).  Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de performance em relatórios e modelos, propondo melhorias com base em:  Estratégia de Direct Lake (quando aplicar e quando evitar),  Otimização de layout/visuais e interações,  Ajustes em DAX (medidas, context transition, otimização de cálculos),  Modelagem dimensional e boas práticas de star schema,  Particionamento/organização de dados e padrões de atualização.  Atuar como referência na construção e evolução de arquitetura centralizada no Fabric, garantindo que o consumo analítico esteja alinhado ao Lakehouse/Datalake corporativo e evitando redundâncias.  Desenvolver e evoluir Lakehouses no Fabric, incluindo estruturação dos dados na camada Gold (Redshift) para Unload ao Fabric, carga no Lakehouse Fabric.  Construir e manter Modelos Semânticos no Fabric, incluindo:  Definição de tabelas e relações,  Regras de negócio, métricas e medidas (DAX),  Hierarquias, perspectivas e organização do modelo,  Políticas e boas práticas de segurança (quando aplicável).  Desenvolver dashboards no Power BI conectados ao Fabric (foco Direct Lake), garantindo usabilidade, consistência visual e alta performance.  Apoiar a implementação de padrões de boas práticas.    Requisitos e qualificações   Experiência sólida como Analista Sênior (ou posição equivalente) em ambientes de BI/Analytics.  Domínio de Power BI (modelagem, DAX avançado, performance, boas práticas de visualização e design).  Experiência prática com Microsoft Fabric, incluindo:  Lakehouse (estruturação e consumo),  Notebooks para ingestão/carga/transformação,  Modelo Semântico (Semantic Model),  Desenvolvimento de dashboards consumindo dados do Fabric.  Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Estatística, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;  Desejável pós‑graduação ou especialização em Data Science, Analytics, BI ou áreas afins.    Conhecimentos e Experiências   Conhecimento e experiência em otimização de performance (modelos e relatórios), incluindo análise de causas raiz e proposição de soluções sustentáveis.  Conhecimento de princípios de arquitetura de dados e modelagem (dimensional, star schema, granularidade, relações, cardinalidade).  Capacidade de atuar de forma consultiva: traduzir problemas em hipóteses, testar, medir e recomendar melhorias com clareza.  SQL intermediário/avançado (joins, subqueries, views, procedures)  Vivência com automação de processos e integração via APIs  Conhecimento em ETL: Compreensão de processos de ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) e experiência na construção de fluxos de dados.  Experiência com ao menos uma linguagem de programação, preferencialmente Python.    Competências comportamentais   Perfil analítico e investigativo (forte em troubleshooting e causa raiz).  Comunicação clara com públicos de negócio.  Organização e visão de produto (entregar valor com qualidade e manutenção).  Proatividade para melhorar processos envolvendo Fabric.  Colaboração com os times operacionais e gerenciais.    Informações adicionais    Benefícios que valorizam o seu dia a dia! Disponibilizamos café da manhã para tornar suas manhãs mais leves e produtivas.

Com mais de 80 anos de história, o hospital é um dos mais tradicionais da cidade. Atualmente, o Hospital Vera Cruz conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e pronto atendimento 24h. Além disso, oferece atendimento em mais de 66 especialidades médicas e possui Acreditação ONA 3, estando em processo de preparação para a certificação JCI. Também adquirimos a Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais emblemáticos da cidade, instalado em um prédio centenário que faz parte do patrimônio particular local. No mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2care.  Essas aquisições reforçam as consolidações da nossa região, que fazem parte do grupo Hospital Care. Fundado em 2017, o Hospital Care nasceu da união de pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar no Brasil. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde, com um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, focado no equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Nosso sistema de saúde é completo, com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.  Como estratégia, estamos presentes em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais de gestão de saúde, nos estados de São Paulo, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos consolidar como a principal Rede de Prestadores de Serviços de Saúde do Brasil.  #vemserveracruz #vemparahospitalcare #vemserhospitalcare #vemproveracruz  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Prestar atendimento ao cliente;  Autorizar procedimentos dos pacientes;  Realizar as demandas do setor de Internação;  Apoiar as rotinas de faturamento;  Atender o telefone e direcionar as chamadas para o setor correto;  Manter descrição e sigilo dos pacientes/acompanhantes que frequentam o Hospital;  Recepcionar clientes, acompanhantes e visitantes procurando identificá-los, averiguando suas pretensões para prestar-lhes atendimento, informações e/ou encaminhá-los ao setor correto. Be an ambassador in best‑practice definition and creative thinking.    PROFILE REQUIRED   Experience with the following technologies is an advantage:      Snowflake  DBT  Microsoft SQL Server  Power BI  Git      Fluent in programming languages such as SQL and Python is an advantage.  Experience in using cloud BI technologies such as Azure or similar is an advantage.  Experience translating business requirements into advanced data models for analysts and data scientists is an advantage.  Experience working within an agile team is an advantage.  Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PPT or equivalents.  Self‑motivated and able to work independently.  Capable of prioritizing multiple tasks while still meeting deadlines.  Excellent written and oral communication skills with a strong ability to connect the dots.  Detail‑oriented, passionate about quality and enthusiastic about new technology.  Fluent English, spoken and written. French preferred.    ADDITIONAL INFORMATION   Opportunity to work at a large, well‑known and reputable international organization spanning 16 countries.  Opportunity to network and make connections with Brazil and Canada’s best and brightest future professionals.  Opportunity to work at a fully bilingual organization. O seu dia a dia:   Conduzir a estruturação e manutenção dos indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) da Vice-Presidência Executiva (VPE), definindo métricas estratégicas, critérios de apuração, periodicidade e responsáveis.  Assegurar a consistência metodológica e a aderência às diretrizes corporativas dos KPIs.  Desenvolver e manter dashboards executivos e operacionais em ferramentas de Business Intelligence (BI), integrando dados de múltiplas fontes, como ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), sistemas legados, planilhas e APIs (Application Programming Interfaces).  Garantir visualização clara, geração de insights acionáveis e suporte à tomada de decisão em tempo real por meio dos dashboards.  Realizar comparativos entre valores realizados e planejados, identificando desvios relevantes.  Propor planos de ação e preparar materiais para reuniões com intuito de apoiar a alta liderança na gestão estratégica.  Identificar gargalos operacionais, propor soluções estruturadas e fomentar uma atuação consultiva orientada a resultados.  Mapear, propor e implementar iniciativas de automação e padronização de processos utilizando ferramentas digitais, como Robotic Process Automation (RPA), workflows, aplicativos e Inteligência Artificial (IA). (desejável)  Consolidar dados de desempenho, coordenar a agenda executiva e garantir a qualidade das entregas e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos.  Estruturar e manter a governança de dados e indicadores da VPE.  Traduzir dados complexos em narrativas claras, com foco em riscos, oportunidades, tendências e recomendações práticas.  Conduzir análises de viabilidade e impacto de iniciativas estratégicas.  Fomentar a cultura de dados e a tomada de decisão baseada em evidências.  Exerce cargo de confiança em razão da natureza e relevância das suas atividades. Conheça um pouco sobre nós:  Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.  Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.  Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.  Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Staff Software Engineer | Credit Cards
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Staff Software Engineer | Credit Cards em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us  Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology‑leading companies in the world. Nubank was listed on the NYSE in 2021 and was recently named one of Time Magazine's 100 Most Influential Companies. For more information, visit  About the Role  At Nubank, our Credit Card platform is the core of our global expansion. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our platform team as a technical anchor, ensuring our systems remain scalable and flexible as we maintain sustainable growth and innovation in the countries where we currently operate, while also launching into new international markets. You will play a vital role in evolving the architecture of one of our most complex and strategic products.  You will operate within a high‑impact triad alongside Product and Management, focusing on long‑term technical strategy and system health. As a hands‑on technical leader, you will challenge the status quo, propose innovation and solve deep architectural problems, mentor and become a technical reference for our engineering team. Your work will directly enable millions of customers to access financial products via credit card worldwide.  Responsibilities   Define and drive the long‑term vision and strategy for the global architecture of the core credit card platform, ensuring exponential scalability and continuous evolution capability.  Lead the strategic partnership with Product and Business leadership (C‑level and VPs) to shape the medium and long‑term technical roadmap and define the strategic OKRs and global impact KPIs.  Act as a technical and cultural reference, defining the highest standards of engineering excellence, mentoring other Architects and Principal/Staff Engineers, and fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.  Lead and resolve the most ambitious and high‑risk technical challenges, intervening in critical performance or resilience bottlenecks and driving technical execution for solutions with multi‑system and multi‑country impact.  Design and oversee the execution of complex system transformations (e.g., core banking migrations, replacement of legacy platforms) ensuring regulatory compliance in multiple jurisdictions and fiscal regimes, proactively mitigating risks.  Communicate and defend the technical strategy eloquently and convincingly to the executive board and non‑technical audiences, translating architecture decisions into business value and competitive advantage.    Required Qualifications   Principal/Staff Engineer level experience or equivalent with an extensive and demonstrable history in architecting and scaling mission‑critical, high‑volume, and low‑latency systems in global fintech or e‑commerce environments.  Expert proficiency (demonstrated in code and design) in multiple programming paradigms, with significant hands‑on experience in functional programming (e.g., Clojure, Scala, Haskell) and reactive/event‑based architectures.  Proven ability to establish and lead the long‑term technical strategy for entire platform ecosystems (not just isolated components), influencing the direction of multiple engineering groups.  Deep and successful experience in navigating and defining the architecture in highly regulated financial environments (e.g., BACEN, FCA, SOX) and designing systems to meet data residency requirements and complex cross‑border transactions.  History of successfully leading and completing large‑scale platform transformations (e.g., transition from monoliths to microservices mesh, migration of data centers or clouds), managing risks and operational impact. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Data Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About us  AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.  About AB InBev Growth Group  Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.  In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.  About the Opportunity  We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with a software development background  to lead and evolve data tracking and event instrumentation  for digital products. This role focuses on building reliable, scalable, and high‑quality data collection at the source, working closely with Engineering, Product, Analytics, and Data teams.  This is a hands‑on senior role with strong technical ownership and influence over tracking standards and implementation practices.  What you'll do   Technically lead decisions related to data tracking and event instrumentation , defining standards and best practices across web and mobile applications.  Design and implement data tracking and event instrumentation  solutions for digital products.  Work directly in application code to implement, maintain, and evolve tracking events , ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability.  Partner with Product, Analytics, and Data teams to define events, properties, and tracking plans aligned with business objectives.  Integrate applications with tracking tools and CDPs  (e.g., Segment), ensuring secure and reliable data delivery.  Define and implement technical validations and control mechanisms  to ensure events are correctly fired and schemas remain consistent.  Support and enforce data quality and data governance practices  applied to data collection from the source.  Investigate and resolve complex tracking issues, including broken events, data loss, and integration failures , performing root cause analysis.  Perform impact analysis  related to changes in application code, tracking events, and downstream integrations.  Create and maintain technical documentation on instrumentation patterns, tracking standards, and data flows.  Act as a technical reference and mentor , guiding other engineers on best practices for data tracking and instrumentation.    What you'll need   Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related fields.  Solid experience as a Senior Software Engineer or Senior Data Engineer , with strong hands‑on development experience.  Proven experience with event instrumentation and data tracking  in digital products.  Hands‑on experience with tracking tools / CDPs  (e.g., Segment, RudderStack, Snowplow).  Strong experience working with APIs, SDKs, and system integrations .  Ability to analyze and debug complex technical issues related to tracking and data collection.  Strong SQL, Python and Data Modeling   Working with Databricks and Git   Experience working collaboratively with Product, Analytics, and Data teams.  Advanced English.    Nice to Have   Experience with event-driven architectures .  Familiarity with data observability and monitoring  practices.  Experience in digital products, mobile apps, or DTC platforms .  Knowledge of privacy, consent management, and data protection regulations .  Exposure to data platforms or analytics pipelines.  Spanish    More about you   You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;  You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;  Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;  You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;  You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;  You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.    What We Offer   Performance based bonus*  Attendance Bonus*  Private pension plan  Meal Allowance  Casual office and dress code  Days off*  Health, dental, and life insurance  Medicines discounts  WellHub partnership  Childcare subsidies  Discounts on Ambev products*  Clube Ben partnership  Scholarship*  School materials assurance  Language and training platforms  Transport allowance    *Rules applied  Equal Opportunity & Affirmeative Action  AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmeative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon of race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.  The following fields are optional, but anticipate the information for your registration*.  Remember: your data will never be used as elimination criteria in selection processes. With them, AB InBev Growth Group is able to analyze diversity and reduce biases in selection processes. We want to contribute to changing this reality by being an inclusive company. A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado.  Agir como empreendedor: Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? E não se trata de dar essa oportunidade para poucos, mas de tornar isso possível para todos. No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.  Crescer na jornada: Nossa cultura é forte. Então, só faz sentido empreender aqui caso você se identifique muito com ela. Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.  Nosso time de Tecnologia  Muito mais do que código e sistemas — é o meio essencial que torna possível o nosso modelo único, que combina o melhor do digital com a presença física e humana. Aqui, tecnologia não é um fim em si mesma, mas a ponte entre inovação e a experiência real do cliente. Atuam lado a lado com as áreas de negócio para garantir soluções robustas, escaláveis e centradas nas pessoas, sem abrir mão de um olhar técnico e científico aprofundado em frentes como desenvolvimento de software, infraestrutura, cibersegurança e arquitetura. É nessa interseção entre propósito, técnica e impacto que constroem o presente e futuro.  Seus desafios para crescer na jornada   Definir, implementar e evoluir a estratégia de infraestrutura híbrida, integrando ambientes on‑premises e múltiplos provedores de cloud pública.  Gerenciar e operacionalizar os serviços de Cloud, Datacenter, Bancos de Dados e Observabilidade, garantindo alta disponibilidade, segurança, performance e otimização de custos.  Liderar a Plataforma Interna de Engenharia (Internal Developer Platform – IDP), assegurando uma experiência fluida, padronizada e altamente produtiva para os times de desenvolvimento.  Gerenciar o time de SRE (Site Reliability Engineering), promovendo automação, resiliência, observabilidade, autosserviço e melhoria contínua.  Definir e implementar boas práticas de engenharia de plataforma, abrangendo governança, padronização, automação (IaC), GitOps, CI/CD e provisionamento self‑service.  Colaborar com times de Segurança, Arquitetura, Qualidade e Desenvolvimento para assegurar alinhamento tecnológico, boas práticas e conformidade.  Estabelecer, monitorar e evoluir indicadores operacionais e de confiabilidade (SLA, SLO, SLI).  Planejar capacidade, escalar serviços e garantir resiliência para sistemas críticos.  Gerenciar contratos, fornecedores, custos e orçamentos relacionados à infraestrutura e plataforma.    O que você precisa para se tornar um Agilizado?  Requisitos   Experiência sólida em infraestrutura híbrida, combinando cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e ambientes on‑premises.  Conhecimento profundo em observabilidade (monitoramento, logs, métricas, tracing).  Domínio de Kubernetes e ecossistema cloud‑native (obrigatório para dialogar bem com SRE e engenharia de plataforma).  Conhecimento básico a intermediário de arquitetura de software, incluindo microserviços, padrões de qualidade, estratégias de testes e integração.  Experiência com SRE, incluindo automação, confiabilidade, escalabilidade, performance e gerenciamento de incidentes.  Vivência com Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), DevOps, GitOps, CI/CD e infraestrutura como código.  Gestão orçamentária voltada para infraestrutura e cloud, incluindo planejamento financeiro e uso eficiente de recursos.  Conhecimento em FinOps, incluindo governança financeira, otimização de custos, chargeback/showback e análise de consumo.  Forte capacidade de liderança, gestão de pessoas e desenvolvimento de times multidisciplinares.  Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e articulação com públicos técnicos e executivos.  Conhecimentos de segurança em infraestrutura e práticas como IAM, Zero Trust e governança de cloud.  Visão sistêmica, orientação a resultados e capacidade de conduzir transformações tecnológicas.    Benefícios e facilidades   Saúde e bem‑estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, teleatendimento psicológico e médico gratuito, Totalpass, Vale‑refeição e alimentação e Seguro de vida/auxílio‑funeral.  Maternidade e paternidade: auxílio‑creche, licença‑maternidade de 6 meses, licença‑paternidade de 20 dias, VA/VR no período da licença.  Previdência privada.  Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) seguindo as regras estabelecidas anualmente.  Vale‑transporte.  Fretado de ida e volta para Campinas e região (com raio de até 50 km de distância). São lugares reserváveis mediante a disponibilidade de assentos e rota. Para quem vai de carro, temos estacionamento gratuito.  Folga de presente no mês do seu aniversário.  Dinheiro de volta no Cartão de Crédito: 1% de cashback sobre o valor total da fatura do cartão revertido em crédito na fatura seguinte.  Conta remunerada: CDB de aplicação automática e rendimento de 100% do CDI.  Isenção de Tarifas de Comunicação Digital.   Crédito do Trabalhador: taxa e prazo diferenciados. Disponível para contratação a partir de 6 meses de casa.  Antecipação Saque aniversário do FGTS.  Dr. Pet: possibilidade fazer plano de saúde para pets com até 20% de desconto.    Empresa contratante: HypeFlame  Programa Tô de dono  O Tô de Dono é mais do que um programa de incentivo a longo prazo – ele é o reconhecimento de quem vive diariamente a nossa cultura. A cada ano, o Programa tem novos participantes, colaboradores que se tornam donos do negócio e ganham com a valorização do Agibank sempre que a empresa cresce. Então, quem faz parte dessa história é quem mergulha de cabeça nos desafios para entregar grandes resultados. É assim que construímos, verdadeiramente, uma cultura de donos. Aqui, a fórmula é simples: você cresce. O Agibank cresce com você.  Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia no LinkedIn e Youtube.  Confira nossas avaliações no Glassdoor.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:
Empresa está contratando Lead Security Engineer (GRC) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About us   Nubank was founded in 2013 with the mission of fighting complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. Today, we are one of the largest digital banking platforms in the world, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our careers page:   About the team   The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team enables Nubank to remain compliant with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements, while continuously identifying, classifying, and monitoring risks and providing strategic insights and performance evaluation to leadership.  The GRC squad collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to align our technology security strategy with Nubank’s overall business objectives, ensuring that identified risks are mitigated and that risk-based decision-making is enabled within and beyond the IT & Security Business Unit.  About the role   You will be responsible for acting as a technical reference in security, certifications, and internal controls, serving as a bridge between engineering, risk, audit, and business stakeholders.  You will define strategies, support risk-based decision-making, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are effectively embedded into processes, systems, and products.  Key responsibilities    Act as a senior technical and governance reference across security, certifications, risk, and internal controls, influencing strategy.  Identify control gaps and improvement opportunities in technical procedures required for certification and recertification processes (e.g., ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).  Develop and maintain strong partnerships with business and technical leaders to orchestrate audits, assessments, and remediation plans in a risk-based and scalable way.  Collaborate with technical teams to define action plans that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies.  Conduct assessments of internal controls, ensuring adherence to internal policies, legal requirements, and industry standards.  Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the internal controls landscape and lead control reviews, ensuring timely resolution of issues.  Work closely with Risk teams to align on the mitigation of identified risks.  Support responses to audit requests, regulatory inquiries, and due diligence from business partners.  Partner with Engineering, Product, IT, and global teams to integrate compliance and security requirements into processes and systems.  Define and monitor KRIs and KPIs, delivering forward‑looking, data‑driven insights to senior management and Committees.  Drive continuous improvement and scale, simplifying processes and strengthening Nubank’s Security Maturity as the company grows globally.    Qualification Requirements    Solid experience in information security, with strong knowledge of frameworks such as PCI-DSS, ISO 27000 family, NIST, and similar.  Prior experience with security certification processes and/or internal controls, compliance, and audit support.  Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees.  Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators.  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Security Information, Risk Management or related fields.  Familiarity with using AI and automation (e.g., machine learning, generative AI, or LLM-based tooling) to enhance security compliance use cases.  Knowledge of the regulatory landscape relevant to financial services, such as SOx, BACEN, CVM, CNBV, ANBIMA, SEC, and related regulations.  Hands‑on experience with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP) and implementing security controls in these contexts.  Advanced English (written and verbal) required.    Nice to have Requirements    Relevant certifications such as CRISC, CISA, Security+, CISSP, or CISM are considered a strong plus.    International experience is highly desirable.  Benefits    Chance of earning equity at Nubank  Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)  NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program  Life Insurance  Medical Plan  NuLanguage – Language Course Program  Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses  Extended Parental Leave  Daycare Allowance  Parental Consultancy  Work-from-home Allowance  30 days of paid vacation  Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior IT Engineer – Global Offices Network
description:

About Us  Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building.  Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank.Learn more about our career opportunities here.  About the Role  We are looking for a Senior IT Engineer  to design, implement, and operate our global office and data center network . In this role, you will own the connectivity and performance of Nu’s physical locations, ensuring that our offices and data centers are reliable, secure, and ready to support our next waves of growth.  You will work on routing, switching, wireless, security, and observability  across our global stack, leading key initiatives such as new office rollouts, critical connectivity improvements, and the evolution towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) . You will be part of the Global Offices Network  team, working closely with peers in Connectivity, Security, and Workplace to provide a seamless experience for Nubankers worldwide.  What You’ll Be Responsible For  Network & Connectivity    Design, implement, and support enterprise network infrastructure  for offices and data centers, including routing, switching, and wireless.  Maintain and evolve high‑availability data center fabrics  (e.g., spine‑and‑leaf topologies with Juniper/Cisco hardware).  Ensure robust connectivity between offices and data centers , including WAN and SD‑WAN solutions, focusing on performance, reliability, and scalability.  Configure and support wireless networks  (controllers and access points), with strong experience in vendors such as Aruba  and Cisco.  Operate and tune load balancers  (e.g., F5 , including DNS/ZoneRunner concepts) to guarantee optimal application delivery and resilience.  Collaborate with security teams on Next‑Generation Firewalls  (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet) and cloud security brokers  (e.g., Zscaler) in a “security‑first” network design.    Automation, IaC & Observability    Drive the transition away from manual configuration towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC)  using tools such as GitHub, Terraform, and/or Ansible .  Implement and maintain network performance monitoring  and observability using tools like PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds or similar , ensuring proactive detection and resolution of incidents.  Manage PKI-related activities , including SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle and ensuring secure encrypted communications across services and endpoints.    Delivery & Collaboration    Lead or co‑lead new office implementations  and major network changes, coordinating with Workplace, Connectivity, and other partner teams.  Act as a technical reference for incident response and problem management  in critical networking issues, helping restore services quickly and preventing recurrences.  Document architectures, runbooks, and standards, helping scale knowledge across the team.  Mentor more junior engineers and collaborate in a multi‑level team  (IC6, IC5, IC3, IC4) to continuously improve how we operate our global infrastructure.    We Are Looking for a Person Who Has   5+ years of experience  in enterprise networking or infrastructure engineering , working with critical environments (e.g., large offices, data centers, or mission‑critical operations).  Strong hands‑on experience with routing and switching , ideally using vendors such as Cisco  and/or Juniper.  Experience implementing and supporting wireless networks , especially with Aruba  and/or Cisco wireless solutions.  Solid experience operating network monitoring and performance tools  (e.g., PRTG, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Grafana  or similar) in production environments.  Experience with load balancers  (e.g., F5 ) and DNS‑related components (e.g., ZoneRunner  or equivalent).  Exposure to network security components , such as enterprise firewalls and/or security brokers, and comfort collaborating with security teams in a “security‑first” posture.  Experience with or strong interest in Infrastructure as Code (IaC)  and automation for network configuration and lifecycle management (e.g., GitHub, Terraform, Ansible ).  Ability to lead initiatives and coordinate teams  during new office rollouts, complex changes, and incident response.  Strong problem‑solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work in cross‑functional, multicultural teams .  Intermediate English  (spoken and written), with the ability to participate in meetings and collaborate with global teams.    Nice to Have   Familiarity with Zero Trust  network concepts and security‑driven networking.  Experience with cloud networking  (e.g., connectivity to public clouds) and hybrid environments.  Experience with security mindset and encryption  topics (e.g., secure protocols, network segmentation), even if not your primary specialization.  Prior experience in distributed or global organizations .    Location  This opportunity is based in Brazil , with a strong preference for candidates who can work from our offices in:  You will be part of the Brazil Global Offices Network team and collaborate with colleagues in other locations as needed.  For employees based in Brazil , we offer:   Chance of earning equity  at Nubank  Public Transportation Commuting Benefit  (Vale-Transporte)  NuCare  – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program  Life Insurance   Medical Plan   NuLanguage  – Language Course Program  Nucleo  – Our learning platform of courses  Extended Parental Leave   Daycare Allowance   Parental Consultancy   Work-from-home Allowance   30 days of paid vacation   Relocation Assistance Package , if applicable    Work Model for This Role  This role follows our hybrid work model . Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least 2–3 times per week , on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit our article about Nu’s hybrid work model.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

About Us  Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology‑leading companies in the world. Nubank was listed on the NYSE in 2021 and was recently named one of Time Magazine's 100 Most Influential Companies. For more information, visit   About The Role  At Nubank, our Credit Card platform is the core of our global expansion. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our platform team as a technical anchor, ensuring our systems remain scalable and flexible as we maintain sustainable growth and innovation in the countries where we currently operate, while also launching into new international markets. You will play a vital role in evolving the architecture of one of our most complex and strategic products.  You will operate within a high‑impact triad alongside Product and Management, focusing on long‑term technical strategy and system health. As a hands‑on technical leader, you will challenge the status quo, propose innovation and solve deep architectural problems, mentor and become a technical reference for our engineering team. Your work will directly enable millions of customers to access financial products via credit card worldwide.  Responsibilities   Define and drive the long‑term vision and strategy for the global architecture of the core credit card platform, ensuring exponential scalability and continuous evolution capability.  Lead the strategic partnership with Product and Business leadership (C‑level and VPs) to shape the medium and long‑term technical roadmap and define the strategic OKRs and global impact KPIs.  Act as a technical and cultural reference, defining the highest standards of engineering excellence, mentoring other Architects and Principal/Staff Engineers, and fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.  Lead and resolve the most ambitious and high‑risk technical challenges, intervening in critical performance or resilience bottlenecks and driving technical execution for solutions with multi‑system and multi‑country impact.  Design and oversee the execution of complex system transformations (e.g., core banking migrations, replacement of legacy platforms) ensuring regulatory compliance in multiple jurisdictions and fiscal regimes, proactively mitigating risks.  Communicate and defend the technical strategy eloquently and convincingly to the executive board and non‑technical audiences, translating architecture decisions into business value and competitive advantage.    Required Qualifications   Principal/Staff Engineer level experience or equivalent with an extensive and demonstrable history in architecting and scaling mission‑critical, high‑volume, and low‑latency systems in global fintech or e‑commerce environments.  Expert proficiency (demonstrated in code and design) in multiple programming paradigms, with significant hands‑on experience in functional programming (e.g., Clojure, Scala, Haskell) and reactive/event‑based architectures.  Proven ability to establish and lead the long‑term technical strategy for entire platform ecosystems (not just isolated components), influencing the direction of multiple engineering groups.  Deep and successful experience in navigating and defining the architecture in highly regulated financial environments (e.g., BACEN, FCA, SOX) and designing systems to meet data residency requirements and complex cross‑border transactions.  History of successfully leading and completing large‑scale platform transformations (e.g., transition from monoliths to microservices mesh, migration of data centers or clouds), managing risks and operational impact.  In‑depth knowledge of credit card/payment systems design is a significant differential.    Nice to Have   Experience with Clojure or similar functional languages.  Proven interest or experience in leveraging AI to optimize engineering workflows.  Deep domain knowledge of credit card processing or financial ledgers.    Location & Work Model  This role is based on a hybrid model at one of our Nubank offices in Brazil (São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro, or Belo Horizonte), the United States (Palo Alto, Durham, Washington D.C. or Miami), or Canada (Toronto) .  Diversity & Inclusion / Equal Opportunity  At Nubank, we believe that diversity is essential to building the best products and services. We are committed to creating a welcoming work environment that respects and values diversity in all its forms, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.  If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. Vivência com pesquisa aplicada, produção técnica, prototipação ou teste de novas tecnologias. AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands,we’renumber one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.  About ABI GrowthGroup  ABI’s Growth Division is the center of innovation and tech development within ABI, whichis drivingABI’s growth by developing innovations for the core beer business and creating new hyper‑growth tech businesses. ABI Growth includes the following business lines: BEES (our business‑to‑business e‑commerce and SaaS business, also focused on new technologies), TaDaand Ze Delivery (our direct‑to‑consumer e‑commerce businesses), and several other high‑tech divisions, including fintech and venture capital.  This role will be largely dedicated to BEES, which is on a mission to transform ABI’s business‑to‑business sales model by putting customers and data at its heart. Whether you are a small to medium sized retailer or a supplying partner, BEES provides you with the tools, data, and insights you need to help your business thrive. Today, more than 2.5 million retailers across 19 countries use BEES every month to browse for products, place orders, earn rewards, arrange deliveries, manage invoices, and access business insights all from one place.  Learn more on how BEES keeps business buzzing at   About the Role  The Commercial Strategy Specialist is responsible for maximizing profitable growth across BEES Link 3P through strong governance, analytical rigor, and scalable operating standards. Aligned with our mission — to maximize profitable growth by institutionalizing pricing compliance, P&L governance, disciplined product prioritization, and scalable operating processes — this role plays a critical part in strengthening the structural foundations of our commercial model.  This position sits at the intersection of Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. The Commercial Strategy Specialist transforms complex business problems into data‑driven insights and scalable frameworks that protect margins, improve investment allocation, and accelerate disciplined decision‑making. This is a high‑impact role designed for a senior professional who combines strategic thinking with hands‑on analytical execution.  What You'll Do   Own P&L governance for BEES Link 3P, consolidating partner‑level performance data and translating it into clear visibility on margin health, revenue quality, and profitability trends.  Provide broad‑ranging legal advice to other teams across ABI Growth, including relating to SaaS and licensing transactions, strategic commercial relationships, data monetization strategies, data privacy projects, and product counseling.  Build and maintain scalable operating frameworks — standard templates, decision criteria, governance protocols — that reduce dependence on ad‑hoc judgment and improve process consistency.  Drive product prioritization rigor by developing structured intake processes, effort‑impact scoring models, and backlog governance routines that align roadmap decisions with commercial outcomes.  Design and maintain investment evaluation frameworks that assess initiatives against a shared value logic, distinguishing between cost avoidance, governance improvement, and incremental revenue generation.  Develop and update reference models for take rate and GMV impact analysis, enabling leadership to make pricing and product decisions grounded in real partner data.  Identify operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies across the OTC and GTM cycle, and lead initiatives to eliminate waste and improve execution speed without compromising governance standards.  Synthesize cross‑functional inputs — from Commercial, Finance, Product, and Operations — into integrated business reviews that surface risks early and enable proactive course correction.  Support JBP structuring and partner onboarding processes by providing analytical and governance scaffolding that ensures new engagements are commercially sound from the outset.    What You'll Need   Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree (MBA, MSc) is a strong differentiator.  Experience in a business analytics, commercial operations, strategy, or financial governance role, ideally within a technology, marketplace, or CPG environment.  Proven ability to build and operationalize governance frameworks, pricing models, or P&L management tools in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.  Strong analytical proficiency — advanced Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or Python/R — with the ability to work directly with large datasets and translate findings into executive‑level insights.  Demonstrated experience with take‑rate modeling, GMV analysis, or margin management in a platform or marketplace business is a significant plus.  Desire to help build the legal function and data privacy program from the ground up.  Effective communicator who can synthesize complex analytical work into clear business narratives for senior leadership and cross‑functional partners.  Practical legal approach, focused on enabling the business strategy rather than a compliance‑first mindset.  Fully fluent in English and Portuguese; proficiency in Spanish is a plus. Atuar como referência técnica, apoiando desenvolvedores menos experientes e disseminando boas práticas.    Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?    Experiência sólida em backend com Java (preferencialmente 17+), POO e princípios SOLID.  Spring Boot e arquitetura hexagonal; conhecimento de event-driven (ex.: SNS/SQS, eventos de domínio).  APIs RESTful e documentação OpenAPI (Swagger).  Maven (ou Gradle) para build e gestão de dependências.  AWS: uso prático de SNS, SQS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, ECR e DocumentDB/MongoDB. Bancos relacionais e não relacionais; modelagem e domínio de queries.  CI/CD e metodologias ágeis (branching, pipelines, PRs, feature flags). Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?    Profundidade em Keycloak (realms, clients, policies, mappers) e OAuth 2.0 (grants, PAR, JAR, DCR).  Observabilidade avançada: Prometheus, Grafana e OpenTelemetry (traces e métricas end-to-end).  Performance & escalabilidade: baixa latência/alta concorrência (profilers, k6/JMeter, tuning de JVM).  Helm e Infra as Code (Terraform) para padronização de deploys.  JavaScript/TypeScript para manutenção de mocks de testes/interceptors.  Participação em comunidades técnicas, eventos ou projetos open source.  Liderança técnica (guildas, chapters, definição de padrões, mentoria). About Us  Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies in the world. Nubank was listed on the NYSE in 2021 and was recently named one of Time Magazine's 100 Most Influential Companies. For more information, visit About the Role  At Nubank, our Credit Card platform is the core of our global expansion. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our platform team as a technical anchor, ensuring our systems remain scalable and flexible as we maintain sustainable growth and innovation in the countries where we currently operate, while also launching into new international markets. You will play a vital role in evolving the architecture of one of our most complex and strategic products. You will operate within a high-impact triad alongside Product and Management, focusing on long-term technical strategy and system health. As a hands-on technical leader, you will challenge the status quo, propose innovation and solve deep architectural problems, mentor and become a technical reference for our engineering team. Your work will directly enable millions of customers to access financial products via credit card worldwide. Responsibilities  Define and drive the long-term vision and strategy for the global architecture of the core credit card platform, ensuring exponential scalability and continuous evolution capability. Lead the strategic partnership with Product and Business leadership (C-level and VPs) to shape the medium and long-term technical roadmap and define the strategic OKRs and global impact KPIs. Act as a technical and cultural reference, defining the highest standards of engineering excellence, mentoring other Architects and Principal/Staff Engineers, and fostering a culture of innovation and accountability. Lead and resolve the most ambitious and high-risk technical challenges, intervening in critical performance or resilience bottlenecks and driving technical execution for solutions with multi-system and multi-country impact. Design and oversee the execution of complex system transformations (e.g., core banking migrations, replacement of legacy platforms) ensuring regulatory compliance in multiple jurisdictions and fiscal regimes, proactively mitigating risks. Communicate and defend the technical strategy eloquently and convincingly to the executive board and non-technical audiences, translating architecture decisions into business value and competitive advantage. Expert proficiency (demonstrated in code and design) in multiple programming paradigms, with significant hands-on experience in functional programming (e.g., Clojure, Scala, Haskell) and reactive/event-based architectures. Proven ability to establish and lead the long-term technical strategy for entire platform ecosystems (not just isolated components), influencing the direction of multiple engineering groups. Deep and successful experience in navigating and defining the architecture in highly regulated financial environments (e.g., BACEN, FCA, SOX) and designing systems to meet data residency requirements and complex cross-border transactions. History of successfully leading and completing large-scale platform transformations (e.g., transition from monoliths to microservices mesh, migration of data centers or clouds), managing risks and operational impact. In-depth knowledge of credit card/payment systems design is a significant differential.  Nice to Have  Experience with Clojure or similar functional languages. Proven interest or experience in leveraging AI to optimize engineering workflows. Deep domain knowledge of credit card processing or financial ledgers.  Location & Work Model  This role is based on a hybrid model at one of our Nubank offices in Brazil (São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro, or Belo Horizonte), the United States (Palo Alto, Durham, Washington D.C. or Miami), or Canada (Toronto) . title: Gerente Jr de Qualidade (Time Comercial)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Gerente Jr de Qualidade (Time Comercial) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Gerente Jr de Qualidade (Time Comercial) Job Locations: BR-Campinas ID:   Company Overview Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada. Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay). Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais. Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados. #LI-Hybrid  Team Overview Você fará parte do recém-criado time de Qualidade Comercial, como colaborador individual, dentro da nossa estrutura de Enablement Comercial na 99Food, uma operação comprometida em escalar vendas de campo de alta performance com as habilidades, consistência e impacto adequados. Sua missão é atuar como o “guardião da qualidade”, monitorando tudo o que pode dar errado na operação de vendas — desde a execução de habilidades até o uso de sistemas e a aderência a processos — garantindo diagnóstico e correção rápidos. Este papel combina observação em campo, auditoria orientada por dados e feedback estratégico, impulsionando ações imediatas e melhorias de longo prazo no nosso motor de vendas.  Role Responsibilities Projetar, implementar e liderar um framework abrangente de Qualidade de Vendas, incluindo auditorias aprofundadas, scorecards (técnicos, comportamentais, de processo e de uso de sistemas) e mecanismos estruturados de feedback. Conduzir auditorias ao longo de toda a jornada comercial, observando visitas em campo, registros em CRM/sistemas, demonstrações, e-mails e aderência a playbooks, para identificar desvios e oportunidades. Gerenciar, junto ao time, visitas frequentes em campo ao lado de Business Developers para observar a execução em tempo real, avaliar necessidades de coaching e validar o comportamento real versus o documentado. Analisar padrões de uso em CRMs e outras ferramentas comerciais para detectar lacunas, subutilização ou uso indevido, retroalimentando insights para treinamentos, base de conhecimento (KB) e melhorias de processo. Atuar como guardião da excelência: monitorar a conformidade com playbooks, fluxos de processo, base de conhecimento e uso de ferramentas, garantindo alinhamento em cada interação dos BDs. Colaborar com os times de Sales Enablement, Produto, Operações e Tecnologia para traduzir achados de QA em melhorias, aprimorando a base de conhecimento, módulos de treinamento, fluxos de trabalho e sistemas. Produzir relatórios recorrentes com insights de QA, lacunas emergentes, tendências e recomendações priorizadas para ações corretivas rápidas e evolução estratégica. Orientar e desenvolver Especialistas de QA, promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua, consistência e execução de qualidade baseada em dados. Defender melhorias operacionais, de processo e sistêmicas com uma mentalidade orientada por hipóteses e forte alinhamento com princípios mais amplos de Controle de Qualidade.   Role Qualifications Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência em gestão da qualidade, auditoria de processos ou QA de vendas, especialmente em vendas de campo, tecnologia ou ambientes em escala. Capacidade comprovada de desenhar frameworks robustos de QA, incluindo scorecards, matrizes de performance, rotinas de auditoria e fluxos de escalonamento. Alta capacidade analítica: transformar dados quantitativos (CRM, métricas, dashboards) e observações qualitativas (campo, demos) em insights acionáveis. Experiência com plataformas de CRM, monitoramento de uso de sistemas e compreensão de como sistemas impactam o comportamento comercial. Perfil “mão na massa” e presença em campo: conforto para realizar visitas, avaliações presenciais e trabalhar próximo aos times operacionais. Fortes habilidades de comunicação, com assertividade para apontar lacunas operacionais e colaborar entre áreas para resolvê-las. Mentalidade de melhoria contínua, com resultados comprovados na transformação de insights de qualidade em ações práticas (treinamentos, atualizações de KB, refinamentos de processos/sistemas). Certificações como Six Sigma/Black Belt ou experiência em Enablement são diferenciais.   EEO Statement Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar. Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica. Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos. Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos. Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo. Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra. Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso. Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.  Diversidade e Inclusão  Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje. Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias. Essa é a nossa jornada já escrita que ainda tem muito caminho para percorrer. title: Lead Security Engineer (GRC)
description:

Overview  About Nubank: Nubank was founded in 2013 with the mission of fighting complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. Today, we are one of the largest digital banking platforms in the world, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our careers page:   About The Team  The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team enables Nubank to remain compliant with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements, while continuously identifying, classifying, and monitoring risks and providing strategic insights and performance evaluation to leadership. The GRC squad collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to align our technology security strategy with Nubank’s overall business objectives, ensuring that identified risks are mitigated and that risk-based decision-making is enabled within and beyond the IT & Security Business Unit.  About The Role  You will be responsible for acting as a technical reference in security, certifications, and internal controls, serving as a bridge between engineering, risk, audit, and business stakeholders. You will define strategies, support risk-based decision-making, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are effectively embedded into processes, systems, and products.  Key Responsibilities   Act as a senior technical and governance reference across security, certifications, risk, and internal controls, influencing strategy.  Identify control gaps and improvement opportunities in technical procedures required for certification and recertification processes (e.g., ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).  Develop and maintain strong partnerships with business and technical leaders to orchestrate audits, assessments, and remediation plans in a risk-based and scalable way.  Collaborate with technical teams to define action plans that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies.  Conduct assessments of internal controls, ensuring adherence to internal policies, legal requirements, and industry standards.  Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the internal controls landscape and lead control reviews, ensuring timely resolution of issues.  Work closely with Risk teams to align on the mitigation of identified risks.  Support responses to audit requests, regulatory inquiries, and due diligence from business partners.  Partner with Engineering, Product, IT, and global teams to integrate compliance and security requirements into processes and systems.  Define and monitor KRIs and KPIs, delivering forward-looking, data-driven insights to senior management and Committees.  Drive continuous improvement and scale, simplifying processes and strengthening Nubank’s Security Maturity as the company grows globally.    Qualification Requirements   Solid experience in information security, with strong knowledge of frameworks such as PCI-DSS, ISO 27000 family, NIST, and similar.  Prior experience with security certification processes and/or internal controls, compliance, and audit support.  Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees.  Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators.  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Security Information, Risk Management or related fields.  Familiarity with using AI and automation (e.g., machine learning, generative AI, or LLM-based tooling) to enhance security compliance use cases.  Knowledge of the regulatory landscape relevant to financial services, such as SOx, BACEN, CVM, CNBV, ANBIMA, SEC, and related regulations.  Hands-on experience with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP) and implementing security controls in these contexts.  Advanced English (written and verbal) required.    Nice To Have Requirements   Relevant certifications such as CRISC, CISA, Security+, CISSP, or CISM are considered a strong plus.    International experience is highly desirable.  Benefits   Chance of earning equity at Nubank  Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)  Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)  NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program  Life Insurance  Medical Plan  Dental Plan  NuLanguage – Language Course Program  Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses  Extended Parental Leave  Daycare Allowance  Parental Consultancy  Work-from-home Allowance  Gym Partnerships  30 days of paid vacation  Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable    Work Model for this Role  Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. title: Estágio em Customer Success - Relacionamento
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Estágio em Customer Success - Relacionamento em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Na Chuva, a gente acredita que estágio deve formar, não só ocupar. Por isso, a nossa proposta é simples: trabalho real, aprendizado prático, feedback diário e autonomia conquistada. A gente fala disso desse jeito porque boa parte do mercado ainda funciona na lógica do "drenar" (brain drain): promete desenvolvimento, mas entrega só o mínimo necessário para manter você girando. Nós construímos o oposto disso: Brain Bridges  (Pontes de Conhecimento). Você traz energia, iniciativa, curiosidade e vontade de aprender. Nós entramos com 18 anos de experiência em uma empresa de tecnologia independente, contato direto com os fundadores, acompanhamento e um ambiente seguro para você testar, errar, ajustar e evoluir. Nosso trabalho impulsiona a ciência apoiando mais de 800 mil pesquisadores no mundo  com o Galoá, plataforma que viabiliza o Proceedings Science, o maior acervo de acesso aberto de eventos científicos do Brasil. Se você busca um estágio convencional, o mercado oferece muitas opções. Mas, se você quer uma experiência intensa de aprendizado prático, com tecnologia, responsabilidade e impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui.  O que é o Programa Gerente de Si?  Trabalhar com propósito exige mais autoconhecimento, autonomia e maturidade profissional. A nossa resposta é: como se aprende isso na prática? Na Chuva, transformamos esse desafio em formação concreta. Chamamos isso de Gerente de Si, um jeito de garantir a evolução contínua:   Organização: planejar a própria semana  Priorização: entender o que precisa ser feito primeiro  Levantar a mão: pedir ajuda cedo, sem esconder dificuldades  Accountability: mostrar o andamento do trabalho sem ninguém precisar cobrar  Maturidade: ouvir e dar feedback sem levar para o lado pessoal  Autonomia: usar tecnologia para trabalhar melhor, não só mais rápido    É isso que você vai aprender e praticar aqui ao longo do estágio. Nem tudo será glamouroso. Haverá tarefas operacionais e repetitivas, porque consistência  também forma repertório. Ao mesmo tempo, você terá contato com IA, melhoria de processos e problemas reais de uma empresa em movimento.  Na trilha de Customer Success (Relacionamento) você vai atuar principalmente em quatro frentes:   Comunicação com clientes: Triagem, leitura e envio de e-mails, apoiando pesquisadores de diferentes países com uma comunicação clara, respeitosa e educativa  Uso de IA e configuração de soluções: Apoio em setups, identificação de padrões, resolução de dúvidas recorrentes e treinamento de bots  Precisão de dados e processos: Higienização e importação de dados com alto nível de cuidado, reduzindo erros e retrabalho  Projetos de melhoria: Resolução de pequenos desafios reais com nossa supervisão, buscando deixar processos mais simples, rápidos e confiáveis    O que pode te frustrar aqui   As coisas mudam rápido: Não somos uma empresa engessada. Quando aparece um caminho melhor, ajustamos a rota  A curva de aprendizado é alta: Você não precisa chegar sabendo tudo. Mas precisa querer aprender, se dedicar e evoluir com consistência  Comunicação diária: Você vai ler, escrever, ouvir feedback e precisar pedir ajuda quando travar, em vez de sumir com o problema    Requisitos  Sua parte na ponte (O que você traz para o estágio):   Matrícula ativa e atestada: a partir do 3º ano de qualquer curso de graduação (Exatas, Humanas ou Biológicas)  Disponibilidade e curiosidade: 6 horas por dia (30h semanais)  Afinidade com tecnologia: não irá programar, só não pode ter medo de fuçar em softwares novos e plataformas web  A matéria-prima do Gerente de Si (Autorresponsabilidade): não é saber gestão de tempo e ter inteligência emocional, isso faz parte do que vamos ensinar. Mas precisa trazer humildade para ouvir, coragem para sinalizar quando travar e disposição para assumir responsabilidade pelo próprio desenvolvimento    Benefits   Bolsa + Benefícios: R$ 1.950,00 (R$ 1.200 + R$ 750)  Auxílio transporte: flexível conforme a sua necessidade de deslocamento  Híbrido: pelo menos 3x por semana no nosso QG em Barão Geraldo, perto da Unicamp  Kumbatia e CumbuChuva: investimos o nosso tempo na sua formação adicionando clube do livro e treinamentos internos  Flexibilidade real: Sabemos como é a semana de provas e imprevistos. Ajustamos os horários baseados no seu cronograma escolar    Etapa essencial da candidatura  Antes de concluir sua candidatura, leia nossos materiais de cultura em nosso site. No campo de inscrição, envie 3 perguntas que surgiram da sua leitura. Pelo menos 1 delas deve se conectar à ideia de "sobre ombros de gigantes" e ao tipo de legado que você quer ajudar a construir. Não estamos procurando a pergunta perfeita. Queremos entender se você realmente leu, pensou e ficou curioso(o).   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Aligned with our mission — to maximize profitable growth by institutionalizing pricing compliance, P&L governance, disciplined product prioritization, and scalable operating processes — this role plays a critical part in strengthening the structural foundations of our commercial model.  This position sits at the intersection of Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. The Commercial Strategy Specialist transforms complex business problems into data‑driven insights and scalable frameworks that protect margins, improve investment allocation, and accelerate disciplined decision‑making. This is a high‑impact role designed for a senior professional who combines strategic thinking with hands‑on analytical execution. Identify operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies across the OTC and GTM cycle, and lead initiatives to eliminate waste and improve execution speed without compromising governance standards.  Synthesize cross‑functional inputs — from Commercial, Finance, Product, and Operations — into integrated business reviews that surface risks early and enable proactive course correction. Strong analytical proficiency — advanced Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or Python/R — with the ability to work directly with large datasets and translate findings into executive‑level insights. title: Senior IT Engineer – Global Offices Network
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior IT Engineer – Global Offices Network em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more about our career opportunities here.  About The Role  We are looking for a Senior IT Engineer  to design, implement, and operate our global office and data center network . In this role, you will own the connectivity and performance of Nu’s physical locations, ensuring that our offices and data centers are reliable, secure, and ready to support our next waves of growth. You will work on routing, switching, wireless, security, and observability  across our global stack, leading key initiatives such as new office rollouts, critical connectivity improvements, and the evolution towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) . You will be part of the Global Offices Network  team, working closely with peers in Connectivity, Security, and Workplace to provide a seamless experience for Nubankers worldwide. What You’ll Be Responsible For  Network & Connectivity   Design, implement, and support enterprise network infrastructure for offices and data centers, including routing, switching, and wireless.  Maintain and evolve high-availability data center fabrics (e.g., spine-and-leaf topologies with Juniper/Cisco hardware).  Ensure robust connectivity between offices and data centers, including WAN and SD-WAN solutions, focusing on performance, reliability, and scalability.    Wireless, Load Balancing & Security   Configure and support wireless networks (controllers and access points), with strong experience in vendors such as Aruba and Cisco.  Operate and tune load balancers (e.g., F5, including DNS/ZoneRunner concepts) to guarantee optimal application delivery and resilience.  Collaborate with security teams on Next-Generation Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet) and cloud security brokers (e.g., Zscaler) in a “security-first” network design.    Automation, IaC & Observability   Drive the transition away from manual configuration towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as GitHub, Terraform, and/or Ansible.  Implement and maintain network performance monitoring and observability using tools like PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds or similar, ensuring proactive detection and resolution of incidents.  Manage PKI-related activities, including SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle and ensuring secure encrypted communications across services and endpoints.    Delivery & Collaboration   Lead or co-lead new office implementations and major network changes, coordinating with Workplace, Connectivity, and other partner teams.  Act as a technical reference for incident response and problem management in critical networking issues, helping restore services quickly and preventing recurrences.  Document architectures, runbooks, and standards, helping scale knowledge across the team.  Mentor more junior engineers and collaborate in a multi-level team (IC6, IC5, IC3, IC4) to continuously improve how we operate our global infrastructure.    We Are Looking for a Person Who Has   5+ years of experience in enterprise networking or infrastructure engineering, working with critical environments (e.g., large offices, data centers, or mission-critical operations).  Strong hands-on experience with routing and switching, ideally using vendors such as Cisco and/or Juniper.  Experience implementing and supporting wireless networks, especially with Aruba and/or Cisco wireless solutions.  Solid experience operating network monitoring and performance tools (e.g., PRTG, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Grafana or similar) in production environments.  Experience with load balancers (e.g., F5) and DNS-related components (e.g., ZoneRunner or equivalent).  Exposure to network security components, such as enterprise firewalls and/or security brokers, and comfort collaborating with security teams in a “security-first” posture.  Experience with or strong interest in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation for network configuration and lifecycle management (e.g., GitHub, Terraform, Ansible).  Ability to lead initiatives and coordinate teams during new office rollouts, complex changes, and incident response.  Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work in cross-functional, multicultural teams.  Intermediate English (spoken and written), with the ability to participate in meetings and collaborate with global teams.    Nice to Have   Familiarity with Zero Trust network concepts and security-driven networking.  Experience with cloud networking (e.g., connectivity to public clouds) and hybrid environments.  Experience with security mindset and encryption topics (e.g., secure protocols, network segmentation), even if not your primary specialization.
